channel.title: Chain Times
channel.description: Chain Times reports crypto news: bitcoin and ether markets, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: US secures seizure order for $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: US officials secured court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2bn of crypto stolen from Binance, as efforts to track and freeze the funds continue.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a stablecoin settlement route for participating issuers and acquirers, offering another way to settle card obligations onchain.

item.title: Alta raises $47.5 million for bank-focused blockchain
item.description: Alta says its $47.5 million Series A will fund a blockchain built for banks, with privacy and compliance controls aimed at moving financial assets across borders.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, expanding where they can settle payment obligations onchain.

item.title: PNC starts Coinbase-powered USDC payments pilot for businesses
item.description: PNC clients can receive USDC on Ethereum through Coinbase and have it converted into dollars in a bank account, in a limited corporate payments pilot.

item.title: Treasury orders U.S. firms to block transfers to MEXC
item.description: FinCEN says MEXC handled at least $16.7 billion in likely illicit funds and orders U.S. financial firms to block transfers involving the crypto exchange.

item.title: Treasury moves to cut MEXC off from U.S. financial system
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. institutions to block transfers involving MEXC, citing $16 billion in alleged illicit flows and raising the stakes for the global exchange.

item.title: Treasury orders U.S. firms to cut off MEXC transfers
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. firms to block transfers involving MEXC, citing at least $16 billion in alleged illicit flows and links to Russian sanctions evasion.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7, cutting target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting its target interval to 25 seconds and limiting shielded activity to ease wallet syncing and speed private payments.

item.title: Why a failed teleswap exchange can leave you with teleBTC
item.description: A failed TeleSwap swap can still leave teleBTC in your wallet: the bridge may have wrapped the Bitcoin before the token exchange failed. Here is how the steps differ.

item.title: FBI links Binance theft of more than $6 billion to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance in October and is converting the assets into ether, prompting a push to block laundering routes.

item.title: How renbridge turned Bitcoin into renBTC for DeFi
item.description: Renbridge used RenVM to lock Bitcoin and mint renBTC on Ethereum, opening access to DeFi while adding bridge, contract and network risks.

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $76,000 as AI selloff hits crypto
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $76,000 as an AI stock rout dragged crypto lower and forced more than $1 billion in liquidations; Wintermute’s Jasper De Maere stayed positive longer term.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview preceded $6.34 billion hack
item.description: Binance says attackers used a fake recruiter and malware to reach wallet systems before $6.34 billion in crypto was affected, exposing a months-long breach.

item.title: Tether CEO puts its bitcoin holdings at 150,000
item.description: Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino says the company holds about 150,000 bitcoin, far above the amount implied by its latest reserve report, with the gap unexplained.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview helped hackers steal $6.34 billion
item.description: Binance says hackers stole $6.34 billion after a fake job interview helped them reach wallet systems, exposing how staff access can put customer assets at risk.

item.title: Binance customers pull $4.72 billion after $6.3 billion hack
item.description: Binance says hackers stole about $6.3 billion and it will cover the loss; customers have withdrawn $4.72 billion since withdrawals resumed.

item.title: Binance says hot-wallet breach caused $6.3 billion loss
item.description: Binance says attackers took about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets, prompting a withdrawal halt as it secures systems and works to recover assets.

item.title: Binance estimates $6.3 billion impact from security incident
item.description: Binance says a security incident may have used an engineer’s compromised laptop to trigger unauthorized withdrawals, with about $3 billion frozen so far.

item.title: Binance plans phased withdrawals after $6.3B hack
item.description: Binance says it is reopening withdrawals in stages after a $6.3 billion hack, and has replaced about 95% of affected assets with company funds so far.
